key_decisions.decision: Retain the royal palace term for the temple and the contrast within David’s speech.
Preserve the full materials list while noting uncertain ancient stone identifications.
Render filling the hand as consecration and connect willingness to the gift appeal.
Keep all quantities and the later coin term darics rather than disguising it.
Take our father with Israel while recording the alternative divine address in a note.
Retain both resident-status terms and the mortal shadow image, making the contextual object of hope clear.
Keep all three instruction terms, whole-heartedness, and the temple-palace vocabulary.
Preserve the shared bodily homage without implying identical divine status.
Preserve the explicit second installation and the separate priestly anointing.
Retain the LORD’s throne and the all-Israel response.
